strongest_angle: Examining the legal showdown and federal court injunction blocking restrictions on major news organizations from the White House complex.

key_facts.fact: U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly issued an injunction preventing the White House from banning CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the grounds.
U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly found that the ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico likely violated the First Amendment.
The Trump administration blocked access to CNN, MS Now and Politico from the White House complex in September.
